writing.title: Graph description
writing.prompt: The table below shows the percentage of people in one country who used the internet daily, by age group, in 2005, 2015 and 2025: 16–24: 70%, 85%, 97%; 25–44: 55%, 80%, 95%; 45–64: 25%, 60%, 88%; 65+: 5%, 25%, 62%. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

writing.title: Remote work
writing.prompt: More and more people work from home rather than in an office. Do the advantages of this development outweigh the disadvantages? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

writing.title: AI in education
writing.prompt: Some people think that artificial intelligence tools should be used in classrooms from an early age, while others believe this harms learning. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

writing.title: Rewrite for clarity
writing.prompt: Write a clear paragraph (80+ words) explaining why public libraries are still important in the digital age, using at least one transition and one specific example.
